precepts.text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth. Covered with what? Sin, lies, deceit. And gross darkness the people. And the people is talking about the twelve tribes. We are in the worst type of darkness. But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
precepts.point: And the vail that is spread over all nations.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
“And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.” He is going to destroy all the lies this white man cast over all people: that God is white, Jesus is white, the angels are white, the Jews are white. Isaiah 60 is a precept for that verse.

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth.” Covered with what? Sin, lies and deceit. That darkness is the covering cast over all people and the vail spread over all nations.

“and gross darkness the people.” The people is talking about the twelve tribes. We are in the worst type of darkness, because the lies were cast over us first and deepest.

“but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.” When the Lord arises upon Israel, the covering is destroyed and his glory is seen on his people. That is the feast in the mountain of Isaiah 25:6: the lies are taken away, the vail is removed, and the people who sat in gross darkness are the ones his glory rests upon.

precepts.text: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy. That is this white man, beginning with the Roman Catholic Church during the time of the Renaissance. The blasphemy is lies. Wicked lies. Against God, to blaspheme his name. So the Roman Catholic Church, Christianity, blasphemed the name of God. And his tabernacle, that is the Israelites. And them that dwell in heaven, the angels. And it was given unto him to make war with the saints. It was the Roman Catholic Church under Pope Nicholas, out of Rome, that commanded Spain and Portugal to make war with the saints of God. The saints of God are the twelve tribes of Israel. And to overcome them. They overcame us and enslaved us. And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations. And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him. How so? Through verse six, the blasphemy, all the lies, the deceit, the deception he taught when he conquered us and the nations. He taught Christianity. He taught eurocentric lies, white supremacy. Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
precepts.point: And the vail that is spread over all nations.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
How was the covering cast over all people and the vail spread over all nations? Revelation 13 is another precept for it. “And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God.” That is this white man, beginning with the Roman Catholic Church during the time of the Renaissance. The blasphemy is lies, wicked lies. “to blaspheme his name”: the Roman Catholic Church, Christianity, blasphemed the name of God. “and his tabernacle”: that is the Israelites. “and them that dwell in heaven”: the angels.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” It was the Roman Catholic Church, under Pope Nicholas out of Rome, that commanded Spain and Portugal to make war with the saints of God, and the saints of God are the twelve tribes of Israel. They overcame us and enslaved us.

“and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations. And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him.” How so? Through the blasphemy of verse 6: all the lies, the deceit and the deception he taught when he conquered us and the nations. He taught Christianity; he taught Eurocentric lies and white supremacy. “whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.”

That is the covering cast over all people, and it is why a woman on the street will say she saw Jesus and he was white with long hair, just like the pictures. Colonization starts in the mind. As long as you worship a white Jesus you are not ruling anything. But in this mountain the Lord will destroy that covering, and the lies he spread over all nations with it.

precepts.text: The burden of Babylon: Babylon the great. Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain: that high mountain is America. God says lift up the banner, and the banner is the Bible. Exalt the voice unto them: that's what we do every time we go to camp and every time we do these classes, casting down lies. So the mountain in Isaiah 25:7 is referencing Babylon the great, America.
precepts.point: And how is the Most High going to destroy the covering? He is using us to do that: to cast down the lies and reveal the lies Esau has been telling our people.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
Christ “will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people.” Somebody might ask, what mountain is this? Mount Ararat, Mount Fuji, Mount Kilimanjaro? No. Isaiah 13 shows it: “The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.” That is Babylon the great.

“Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain.” That high mountain is America. God says lift up the banner, and the banner is the Bible. “exalt the voice unto them”: that is what we do every day, every time we go to camp and every time we do these classes, casting down lies. “shake the hand”: rebuke them. “that they may go into the gates of the nobles.”

So the mountain of Isaiah 25:7 is Babylon the great, America, and the covering cast over all people is spread from there. It is not only over the people in America; it is global. Wherever you go, whatever church you sit in, whatever continent, country or island, they all think the white man is God and that Christ is white. Now the same persuasion is being pushed that the UFOs, the chariots, are demonic fallen angels, to turn the minds of the people to fight against Christ.

How did he spread this veil over all nations? His media, his network, his communication, because he is the prince of the power of the air; he controls the airwaves. And how will the covering be destroyed? The Most High is using us to do it: lifting up the banner, the Bible, upon that high mountain, exalting the voice, casting down the lies and revealing the lies Esau has been telling our people.

precepts.text: The strong people shall glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee, for thou hast been a strength to the poor and needy, a refuge from the storm and a shadow from the heat; thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, and the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
precepts.point: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities; thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, at rest, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down, not one stake removed nor any cord broken. You will never take down Jerusalem again. Psalms 46:4-7, God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; the heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved, he uttered his voice, the earth melted; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Psalms 48:1-2, beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, the city of the great King.
precepts.why:
Isaiah 33:19 says “Thou shalt not see a fierce people”, and Isaiah 25 shows why: those fierce nations will be subdued. “Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.” The terrible nations, the ones that made everyone afraid, will themselves fear the Most High.

“For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.” That is us. Verse 4 is Israel: the poor and the needy that the terrible ones have been blasting against like a storm, and God has been our refuge through it.

“Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers”, and that goes right back to verse 3: the city of the terrible nations shall fear. Then, “the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low”: their branch, their people, brought low. So when Isaiah 33 says we shall not see that fierce people of a deeper speech and a stammering tongue, it is because God has brought them down.

“He will swallow up death in victory”. The same thing as in First Corinthians. “and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces”. “and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth”. The Lord will remove this rebuke we're suffering. “for the Lord hath spoken it.” Young people need the end result in mind: we're going to come out on top. Endure.

points: In that day it shall be said, "Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us," and the people will be glad and rejoice in His salvation, for the hand of the Most High rests in this mountain while Moab is trodden down as straw for the dunghill.
